mainEntity.name: Is Expert Rangers a licensed tour operator?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Expert Rangers states that it is fully licensed by Dubai's Department of Tourism and Commerce Marketing (DTCM).

mainEntity.name: What tours does Expert Rangers offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dune buggy safaris, desert safaris, quad biking, Polaris RZR rides, camel treks, private desert dinners, Dubai and Abu Dhabi city tours, yacht trips and team-building tours.

mainEntity.name: Is there a minimum age for dune buggy tours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Self-drive buggy tours list a minimum age, for example 16 years for the 4-seater buggy safari. Check each tour page for its own limit.
Yes. Pickup and drop-off are included on all Expert Rangers tours.

mainEntity.name: What did Teknoppy do for Expert Rangers?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO strategy, tour-page keyword mapping, technical SEO and duplicate URL clean-up, on-page optimisation, entity structure and schema markup.

mainEntity.name: Why do tour operators need their own SEO if they sell on travel platforms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Direct bookings avoid marketplace commission and build a lasting customer relationship.

mainEntity.name: Does Teknoppy offer SEO for tourism businesses in the UAE?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Teknoppy works with tourism and hospitality brands in the UAE, Qatar and Kerala.
